summary: glTF/GLB model loading (Meshopt, KTX2) for Renderable.model, with shared GPU resources and per-node instances.
useWhen: A 3D prototype draws authored models or builds levels from a Blender/glTF scene.
limitations: Animations are not played yet (clips are loaded but no mixer runs).
KTX2 textures need the WebGL renderer (absent in headless sessions).
